biography.value: Earthlords do not hurry. Seismic Authority immediately Restrains as many enemies as possible; Mountain's Fist methodically crushes whatever remains. Their regeneration and DR make sustained damage against them impractical without magical investment. A summoner who has a Cooperative Earthlord has not acquired a tool — they have persuaded a geological force to point itself in a useful direction for a while.

system.attacksNotes:
Mountain's Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 damage (11 + 7 Str).
  • Margin 2: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled + Restrained + knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 18 damage, DR halved (round up) + Grappled + Restrained + Prone; target takes 12 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns; Fortitude [Hard] save each round to break free.

Boulder Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 90/180 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 damage (15 + 3 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); target knocked Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Immovable: Magical forced movement requires the caster to win an opposed check against the Earthlord's Str 8 + Might 8 [Hard]. Earth Bond: While standing on natural earth or stone, regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Seismic Authority (1/day) [Combat]: Strikes the ground once. A 60-foot diameter seismic event occurs. All non-designated creatures on natural ground make Fortitude [Hard] saves. Failure: 32 bludgeoning damage + Prone + Restrained for 1 minute; ally must spend 2 [Interact] actions digging them out or they succeed on a Might/Acrobatics [Hard] check as a full [Combat] action. 1 success: 16 damage + Prone only. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 12. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Earthlord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.
